note: 墓場 is valid but has a rougher or less neutral tone. 墓地 is the ordinary neutral word for cemetery or graveyard in JMdict (ent_seq 1584040 sense 0).
Phim tài liệu naturally means documentary film, but the English definition also includes TV programs and publications; no concise Vietnamese equivalent covers all listed media forms.
櫂 directly includes oar and is suitable for the rowlock-mounted implement. Chèo alone is broad or can be read as a verb; mái chèo is the natural Vietnamese noun for the oar.
擦り切れる usually means wearing out through friction. 劣化 means deterioration or worsening in quality or performance in JMdict (ent_seq 1558420 sense 0), matching the broader gradual decline.
Nữ hoàng can mean a queen or an empress. Nữ hoàng đế specifies a female ruler of an empire, matching 女帝.
Hình trụ tròn specifies a circular cylinder. Mặt trụ tổng quát describes the surface generated from a general closed curve as in the English definition.
牡犬 means a male dog specifically, while this unusual English sense also includes male wolves and foxes; the Japanese term does not cover the full definition.
錆びる and rỉ specifically mean rusting, usually iron corrosion. 酸化 is oxidation in JMdict (ent_seq 1304290 sense 0), and oxy hóa is the general Vietnamese verb for oxidise.
面白さ is directly glossed as fun, enjoyment, and entertainment value, all within the English definition of amusement or pleasure.
Gác can refer to an upper floor or mezzanine. Gác mái specifies the space directly beneath a building's roof.
揉め事 usually means an interpersonal quarrel or dispute. 騒乱 means disturbance, riot, or mayhem in JMdict (ent_seq 1403090 sense 0), matching broader turbulent unrest.
Móng can mean a nail or claw generally. Móng guốc specifies the thick keratin covering at an ungulate's toe.
振り切る is directly glossed as rejecting a request or ignoring it, which matches the supplied reject sense despite its forceful nuance.
Sự bắt is understandable but informal and broader than the legal process. Sự bắt giữ is the natural Vietnamese noun for arrest or taking into custody.
ラケット includes the paddle used in table tennis, and the English definition explicitly describes a solid implement analogous to a tennis racket.
水路 means a waterway or channel; the river context and navigability condition specify the intended part of the waterway.
満ちる is directly glossed as waxing of the moon and matches the apparent increase from new moon to full moon.
アレンジ is a standard Japanese word for a musical arrangement or adaptation of a piece for other instruments or style.
拡大 can describe expansion in a conflict's geographic scope, which is one of the two forms of deliberate escalation named in the English definition.
棹 is mainly the neck of a shamisen or similar traditional instrument. ネック means neck and is used for Western string instruments in JMdict (ent_seq 1092970 sense 0).
信号 is the common Japanese word for a traffic light or traffic signal, and đèn giao thông is the direct Vietnamese equivalent.
残額 is understandable as an account balance but usually means the remaining amount. 残高 is the standard account-balance term in JMdict (ent_seq 1304590 sense 0).
落ち着く usually means calm down or become stable. 定住 means settlement or permanent residence in JMdict (ent_seq 1435620 sense 0), matching fixing one's dwelling.
板 is glossed as both board and plank; the English definition gives the dimensions and material that select the plank sense.
血液検査 means a blood test but not a blood sample; the English definition combines those distinct referents under one noun.
代替 implies replacement or substitution. 別 is glossed as separate, different, or another in JMdict (ent_seq 1509430 sense 1), and 別の is the natural adjectival form here.
愛情 usually means love or deep affection. 感情 means emotion or feeling in JMdict (ent_seq 1212410 sense 0), matching the defined psychological sense.
Đổ is very colloquial slang. Phải lòng is the natural neutral Vietnamese verb for coming to have feelings of love.
Uytky is a nonstandard phonetic spelling. Rượu whisky is the established Vietnamese form for the alcoholic drink.
被害者 is the ordinary Japanese word for a victim, including someone harmed by a crime; the crime context selects the intended type.
ゴール is the common Japanese term for a race finish line, as confirmed by its direct JMdict gloss.
ランク is a general rank. 階級 means social class or rank in JMdict (ent_seq 1203040 senses 0-1), fitting position within a class-based society.
振る is a standard Japanese verb for jilt, dump, or turn down someone romantically, matching the lover context in the definition.
修道院 and tu viện both mean monastery or convent and are valid equivalents for an abbey as a religious community or its buildings.
ダニ includes mites as well as ticks. マダニ is a tick term and is glossed as hard tick or ixodid in JMdict (ent_seq 2059080 sense 0), though it denotes hard ticks specifically.
Mục sư specifically means a Protestant pastor. Giáo sĩ is a broader Vietnamese term for a member of the clergy, matching the general Christian clergyman sense.
Dạo đầu can mean any kind of beginning. Khúc dạo đầu specifies a musical prelude or introductory piece.
Gật is the correct verb root, and gật đầu is the complete, natural Vietnamese expression for nodding the head in agreement.
ワックス commonly means a manufactured polishing or hair product. The JMdict entry 蝋 is glossed as wax (ent_seq 1561230 sense 0), and  ろう is the general substance term.

revision.vi: người đàn ông làm nghề bán hàng

note: Người bán hàng is gender-neutral. Người đàn ông làm nghề bán hàng preserves the male-specific definition while describing selling as his occupation.
